svg.title: The endpoint terms vanish because the total momentum and the empty suffix are zero. Self-duality of the forward cone proves the inequality term by term. The identity also covers the empty tuple. There is a quantitative interior form. If y is in the open tube-height cone, choose r > 0 such that B(y, r) is contained in that cone.
